title: observability-pipeline-ingestion-debug-notes-arjun-wip
summary: Working notes for investigating partial drops of traces and metrics during the 2026-02-24 deployment. Focus areas: OTLP ingestion, kafka consumer lag, sample rates, and sidecar/proxy injection effects.
notes:
Context:
- After the 2026-02-24 lightweight rollout of platform-agent v2.7.1 we started seeing:
  * ~10-30% of traces missing spans (observed as gaps in traces on APM UI)
  * Metric series drop for a subset of customer routes (delta in per-route counters)
  * Sporadic log ingestion errors: '422 Unprocessable Entity' from ingestion-service when forwarding to indexer

Hypotheses (initial):
1) OTLP exporter/sampler mismatch: service side changed sampling config, collector dropping spans due to misinterpreted header/sample flag.
2) Kafka consumer lag / partition reassignment during rollout causing transient data loss.
3) Sidecar/proxy (envoy) HTTP/2 multiplexing issue for OTLP/gRPC causing partial payload drops.
4) Ingestion-service validation tightened (schema change) and is rejecting some log batches.

Commands/queries run so far (timestamps local):
- kubectl -n observability get pods -l app=otel-collector -o wide  -> 2/24 23:15: all collectors on nodes a/b/c restarted during rollout
- kubectl -n observability logs otel-collector-0 --since=2h | grep -i error  -> found repeated: "failed to send batch: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = broken pipe"
- kubectl -n platform exec -it ingestion-service-0 -- curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/validate -d @sample-log.json -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -> returns 422 with body: "{\"errors\": [\"missing field: host.ip\"]}"
- kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.redwood.prod:9092 --describe --group ingestion-consumers -> consumer lag spikes on topic 'traces-raw' partitions 4 & 7 around 23:14-23:20 UTC
- grpcurl -plaintext collector:4317 opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.TraceService/Export < sample-otlp-request.bin -> sometimes returns UNAVAILABLE or times out
- tcpdump on collector node (filter port 4317) -> noticed increased RSTs from envoy-proxy sidecars during rollout window

Log snippets (redacted):
- otel-collector: "2026-02-24T23:16:12Z warn exporter/exporterqueue: failed to send batch, retrying, err=rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer"
- ingestion-service: "2026-02-24T23:17:01Z error validation: document rejected: missing field host.ip (doc id xxxxx)"
- kafka broker: "WARN [GroupCoordinator 1] Consumer group ingestion-consumers rebalancing — member_id changed from X to Y"

What this suggests:
- The timing aligns: collector restarts + consumer group rebalances + increased RSTs = likely transient connectivity issues during rollout.
- The 422s suggest ingestion-service validation changes or newly surfaced missing fields; some log shippers may be missing host metadata after agent upgrade.
- Span drops could be from exporter failing to deliver to collector (connection resets) OR collector failing to forward to kafka when exporter queue errors occur.

Repro attempts / isolated tests:
- POSTed a large sample trace payload directly to collector service (clusterIP) from inside cluster: sometimes completes, sometimes returns UNAVAILABLE. Reproduced RSTs.
- Deployed a patched collector config with increased exporter queue size and non-blocking retry; saw decrease in immediate errors but not eliminated.
- Rolled back one node to agent v2.6.9 and validated: that node's traces appear full (preliminary) -> suggests new agent/sidecar interaction is part of problem.

Immediate mitigation applied (2/25 02:00):
- Temporarily paused rollout to v2.7.1 (stopped canary).
- Increased kafka consumer replication min.insync.replicas to reduce risk of leader loss (coord with infra) — monitor for additional lag.
- Reverted validation change in ingestion-service that enforced host.ip (we will add fallback enrichment) -> 422 rate dropped to near zero.

Open action items / next steps:
1) Priya/Eli: instrument collector to log full OTLP request headers and sizes (masking PII) to check for partial payloads. Add metrics: exporter_failed_count by error_type.
2) Maya: run controlled canary with traffic mirroring to new agent to capture difference in payloads (before/after env injection).
3) Infra/SRE: check network-level metrics during rollout window (node-level tcp retransmits, conntrack evictions).
4) Add a short-lived OTLP ingest probe that sends synthetic traces and asserts receipt end-to-end into kafka topic (automated smoke test).
5) Code/config: revert aggressive sampling config in agent (v2.7.1) that defaults sample_rate=0.1 for internal services — why was this set? Review with release owner.
6) Add defensive enrichment in ingestion-service to populate host.ip from request metadata when missing to avoid 422s.

Notes for postmortem draft:
- Timeline: 23:12-23:25 rollout window correlates with spike in collector exporter errors and kafka consumer rebalances.
- Root cause candidate: combination of (a) sidecar/proxy connection handling changes in agent v2.7.1 causing RSTs on OTLP gRPC, and (b) tightened ingestion validation causing logs to be rejected when host metadata dropped.
- Contributing factors: no end-to-end smoke test for OTLP->kafka during canary; rollout strategy allowed rolling restarts that aligned badly with kafka leader elections.

Quick checks to run next (local):
- curl -v http://localhost:4318/v1/metrics to ensure /ready endpoints are up on collector pods before traffic routing
- kubectl -n observability port-forward svc/collector 4317:4317 and run grpcurl stress test (loop sends) to see failure rate and gather tcpdump in parallel
- run kafka-consumer-groups --describe every 30s during a controlled restart to observe rebalancing behavior

Notes to self (things I tried but didn't fully validate):
- Flipping envoy configuration to use keepalive probes (didn't push to prod).
- Trying to increase conntrack table size on nodes — needs infra approval.
- Observed a couple of "unknown attribute" errors in collector metrics pipeline which I didn't capture fully (file: /var/log/collector/metrics-processor.log) — need to collect.

If nothing else, next 24h plan:
- Stabilize ingestion (paused canary + revert validation) -> monitor for 24h.
- Run smoke probes and automated synthetic trace pipeline.
- Prepare rollback plan for agent and collector config changes if we see new errors when resuming rollout.

Contact list: Priya Shah (lead on collector config), Eli Gomez (ingestion-service), Maya Lin (SRE / rollout owner), Niamh O'Connell (platform infra).

Raw artifacts saved to:

- s3://redwood-obs-dumps/obs-20260224/collector-logs.tar.gz
